title: Threshold parity size for the constructed target
statement: Let $m\ge 7$ and let $s$ be a nonnegative integer. Define a Boolean function on $2^m$ signs by taking the product, over $b=0,\ldots,m-1$, of the signs encoding the mod-two inner products of the two length-$m$ blocks selected from the coordinates indexed by $b$ in the first and second halves of the coordinate range. If this function has a polynomial threshold representation with at most $s$ nonzero Fourier coefficients, then $(2^m)^{\lfloor\log_2(2^m)\rfloor}\le s$.
hypotheses_covered: the constructed target has a polynomial threshold representation with Fourier support size at most $s$
caveat: The target's coordinate-selection rule is intricate; the description summarizes its block-indexing construction.
